exposure: tourniquet binding of the lower uterine segment
outcome: blood loss within 24 h after surgery
cohort: 64 pregnant women with placenta accreta spectrum scores greater than 5.
finding: Abdominal aortic balloon occlusion combined with tourniquet binding of the lower uterine segment reduced intraoperative blood loss, 24-hour blood loss, total input of red blood cells, and the incidence of disseminated intravascular coagulation in women with severe placenta accreta spectrum.
